fields.short_description: Fine small-grain Chinigura rice with unmatched fragrance, perfect for Kacchi Biryani & Firni.

fields.name: Chaldal Organic Roasted Jumbo California Almonds & Cashew Mix 500g
fields.short_description: Crunchy slow-roasted California almonds and whole buttery cashews in resealable zip pouch.
fields.description: Hand-selected premium tree nuts slow-roasted without excessive salt or oil to preserve heart-healthy nutrients. Packed with healthy fats, magnesium, and dietary fiber for quick energy and sustained vitality.

fields.name: Chaldal Organic Royal Afghani Premium Jumbo Medjool Dates 1kg
fields.short_description: Large, juicy caramel-sweet Medjool dates with thin skin and succulent melt-in-mouth pulp.
fields.description: Known as the King of Dates, these premium Medjool dates are handpicked at peak ripeness. Naturally sweet with notes of rich caramel and wild honey. Free from added preservatives and packaged under strict hygienic conditions.

fields.name: Khaas Food Raw Sundarban Wild Flower Natural Honey 500g
fields.short_description: Unprocessed raw forest honey gathered by traditional Mouvals from mangrove blossoms.

fields.name: Khaas Food Ghani-Bhanga Cold-Pressed Extra Virgin Mustard Oil 1L
fields.short_description: 100% pure first-press mustard oil extracted via traditional wooden ghani without heat treatment.
fields.description: Pure cold-pressed mustard oil with its signature pungent aroma and deep golden color. Rich in Omega-3 and natural antioxidants, perfect for traditional Bangladeshi bhorta, pickles, and hearty curries.

fields.name: Khaas Food Premium Kalijeera Aromatic Polao Rice 5kg
fields.short_description: Native ancient aromatic slender rice sourced directly from Dinajpur growers without chemical polish.
fields.description: Khaas Food Kalijeera Rice is famous for its natural floral aroma, slender grains, and exquisite taste. Cultivated naturally and aged properly for superior elongation upon cooking. Ideal for festive Polao, Biryani, and traditional Payesh.

fields.name: Bata Comfit Ergonomic Air-Cooled Memory Foam Walking Loafers
fields.short_description: Ultra-lightweight walking loafers with dual-density memory foam and slip-resistant grip.
fields.description: Enjoy effortless cloud-like walking comfort with the Bata Comfit walkers. Engineered with breathable engineered mesh uppers, antimicrobial arch support, and shock-absorbing EVA outsoles that cradle your feet all day long.

fields.name: Apex Venturini Handcrafted Italian Leather Formal Oxford Shoes
fields.short_description: Full-grain Italian calfskin with hand-burnished toe cap and channeled anti-slip leather sole.

fields.name: Zara Authentic Selvedge Tapered Denim Jeans - Dark Indigo Wash

fields.name: Zara Man Structured Slim-Fit Wool-Blend Formal Blazer - Charcoal Gray

fields.name: Sailor Heritage Geometric Motif Fine Viscose Long Kurti

fields.name: Aarong Heritage Dhakai Jamdani Handloom Silk Saree - Midnight Blue & Silver
